provenance.data: SYNTHETIC. Deterministic point-mass generator in the repository (seed 41). No vehicle, road-test or bench data.
provenance.method: Signals are the committed data/synthetic/<id>.csv files at the audited commit, all 702 rows per scenario at the original 0.05 s grid (no downsampling, no truncation). Values were rounded for size only: time 9 decimals, speed and acceleration 6, requested deceleration 3, forces 2. Identical columns shared between scenarios are stored once in "series" and referenced by key. Columns not needed by MON-001..005 or the plots are omitted (pedals, grade, drive force, regen limit, SOC, battery temperature, mu); "csv_columns" records the full header so MON-010 sees the real column inventory.
provenance.expected: "expected" verdicts and "sweeps" were computed on these rounded arrays with the repository's Python reference (longisafe.analysis.evaluate) during the audit on 2026-11-25. Default-config verdicts equal the repo-stored reports/<id>/analysis.json; the sweeps are not stored in the repo.
provenance.truth: "truth" comes from data/ground_truth/<id>.json. It is used for chart overlays and latency arithmetic only and is never passed to the monitor functions.

scenarios.title: Regen loss at 3 s, friction compensates
scenarios.description: Regen capacity is lost at t=3 s (SOC 98 %), friction brake substitutes; requested net deceleration is still achieved.

fault.description: Plant-level event (not a sensor fault): regen force forced to 0 from t_start until stop; persists to end of braking.

scenarios.title: Acceleration sensor bias
scenarios.description: +1.5 m/s^2 bias injected on accel_long_mps2 for 3.0-5.0 s during a nominal 3 m/s^2 stop.

scenarios.title: Frozen speed sensor
scenarios.description: vehicle_speed_mps held at its t=3.0 s value for 3.0-5.0 s during a nominal 3 m/s^2 stop.

fault.description: held at value sampled at t=3.0 s

scenarios.title: Regen loss at 3 s, no friction compensation
scenarios.description: Regen capacity is lost at t=3 s and friction does not substitute; net deceleration undershoots the request.

fault.description: Plant-level event (not a sensor fault): regen force forced to 0 from t_start until stop; persists to end of braking.
